requirements.title: Template marketplace
requirements.description: Community-contributed templates with ratings and reviews

requirements.title: Statistical significance testing
requirements.description: Admin dashboard shows confidence intervals and statistical significance for A/B tests

requirements.title: Automatic winner selection
requirements.description: System automatically promotes winning variant after reaching significance threshold

requirements.description: Implement Thompson sampling or UCB for dynamic traffic allocation

requirements.title: Heatmap visualization
requirements.description: Click heatmaps and scroll maps per variant

requirements.title: Session replay
requirements.description: Record and replay user sessions for UX analysis

requirements.title: Funnel analysis
requirements.description: Multi-step conversion funnel tracking (landing → CTA → checkout → success)

requirements.title: Agent-generated variants
requirements.description: Agent automatically generates and deploys A/B test variants based on conversion data

requirements.title: Multivariate testing
requirements.description: Test multiple elements simultaneously (hero copy + CTA button + pricing)

requirements.title: Persona-based variants
requirements.description: Generate variants optimized for different user personas

requirements.title: CRM integration
requirements.description: Push leads to HubSpot, Salesforce, or custom CRMs

requirements.title: Email marketing integration
requirements.description: Sync subscribers to Mailchimp, ConvertKit, etc.

requirements.title: Webhook notifications
requirements.description: Custom webhooks for landing page events (form submit, conversion, etc.)

requirements.title: Provider cost is captured and served
requirements.description: Metered OpenRouter inference requests persist provider-reported cost and token metadata in usage events; Business Digest and RevenueSummary report cost without storing a derived margin field.

validation.notes: Provider cost is requested, converted to micro-USD, persisted, and surfaced through focused producer tests.

requirements.title: Revenue is split by checkout line
requirements.description: The revenue summary reports subscription, credit top-up, and other paid checkout lines with amounts and transaction counts while preserving the existing total.

validation.notes: A mixed subscription and credit top-up window is asserted to preserve totals and line identity.
